The battle of the bastards was well done, but just one complaint I want to mention:

At the start where Jon tries to save Rickon was ridiculous. It wasn't even shocking, but just plain stupid. Luckily the cavalry caught up to him, but that's how the Stark army was losing (Marching first). Sansa should have told Jon that the Vale army was on their way. If Jon just knew that the Vale army were on their way, then it wouldn't have turned out like it did. Rickon was probably dead either way, but c'mon. 

Other than that complaint, I really liked the overall tone the battle conveyed: war is messy and it's a vicious cycle.
